title: PFRDA revises MSF naming rules, clarifies how PoPs must display pension fund schemes: Key NPS changes from 1 December
summary: PFRDA has revised NPS scheme naming rules, removing category codes from MSF scheme names while requiring separate risk-category disclosures. It has also clarified how PoPs must display pension fund schemes during subscriber onboarding.&nbsp;

title: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
summary: Treasury yields fell on Tuesday night, as investors sought shelter from a sell-off in equity futures sparked by big victories from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.
